text:
No option can be put forward yet: this run could not test either the £20k MRR target or the monthly-churn limit against its modelled outputs.

- The price comparisons held up under the changes tested, but that robustness does not establish that any option reaches your stated targets.
- Monthly churn under 4% was left unchecked because churn is calculated within the model, not measured on the same scale as the limit. The £20k/month target also lacks a recorded MRR baseline needed to assess that level.
- The comparison rests materially on Olumi-authored estimates for Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn and feature-release value; it is not yet validated evidence.
